landing.title: Ishara — Two-Way Sign Language Translator
landing.heroHeading: Breaking Silence with Intelligent Gesture Translation
landing.heroSub: Seamless two-way translation between Indian Sign Language (ISL) / American Sign Language (ASL) and spoken voice across 10 Indian languages. Powered by on-device AI.
landing.statLanguagesDesc: English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi
landing.statPrivacyDesc: Zero audio or camera feed sent to external servers
landing.statOfflineDesc: Runs anywhere without an internet connection
landing.featureSignToVoiceDesc: Computer vision translates camera gestures into clear spoken natural speech.
landing.featureVoiceToSignDesc: Speech recognition turns spoken voice into animated sign language sequences.
landing.featureEmergencyDesc: One-tap high-decibel siren, screen beacon, and offline emergency help cards.
landing.featureLearnDesc: Structured daily sign lessons, gesture practice, and knowledge quizzes.
landing.step1Desc: Use your webcam for signs or tap microphone to speak in your native language.
landing.step2Desc: MediaPipe landmark tracking & on-device grammar parsing convert tokens instantly.
landing.step3Desc: Hear spoken translation aloud or watch avatar animations.
landing.footerCopy: Ishara — Developed for accessibility and inclusive communication.
landing.voiceToSignSub: Avatar performs sign language in real-time.
landing.empoweringSub: Ishara combines advanced computer vision with friendly 3D interfaces to make communication effortless.
landing.cardDualSupportSub: Full dual vocabulary support for Indian and American Sign Languages.
landing.cardVoiceOutputSub: Crystal clear voice synthesis with emotional pitch and rate modulation.
landing.cardSignLearningSub: Interactive lessons and real-time practice feedback for beginners.
landing.cardLiveTranslationSub: Real-time gesture recognition directly in your browser with MediaPipe.
landing.privacyFeat1Desc: Camera frames and pose landmarks are processed locally in your browser. Video streams are never sent to external servers.
landing.privacyFeat2Desc: Conversation history is stored in Supabase with user Row Level Security (RLS) only when you sign in.
landing.copyright: © 2026 Ishara AI. Built with love for a more inclusive world.

HELLO.desc: Open palm temple salute (ISL) / formal forehead salute (ASL)

THANK_YOU.desc: Flat hand moving outward and down from chin

PLEASE.desc: Two-hand Namaste folded palms (ISL) / circular chest rub (ASL)

HOW_ARE_YOU.desc: Cupped palms rotating outward with questioning posture

YES.desc: Closed fist nodding up and down vertically

NO.desc: Index finger wagging side-to-side (ISL) / snapping shut (ASL)

HELP.desc: Closed fist on flat palm lifting upward

STOP.desc: Vertical open palm barrier facing forward

WATER.desc: Cupped hand near mouth (ISL) / W-handshape at chin (ASL)

HOME.desc: Two hands forming roof gable inverted V (ISL) / cheek tap (ASL)

FRIEND.desc: Clasped hands in front of chest

NAME.desc: H/U shape tapping chest (ISL) / crossed H-fingers (ASL)

LOVE.desc: Crossed wrists over chest or ILY sign
